character.name: Damien Zachari

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling dark energy that emits a faint, wailing frequency resonant with Damien's banshee heritage.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: Allows Damien to create minor supernatural effects like flickering lights, distant wailing whispers, or trembling ground, tied to his blood-mage and banshee lineage.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: Curses a target within 90 feet, taking extra 1d6 necrotic damage from Damien's attacks, and amplifying their heartbeat so he can track them through any obstacle for 1 hour.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: A jagged bolt of dark lightning that arcs to the target, dealing 1d12 lightning damage and siphoning their vitality to strengthen Gáe Bulg.

traits: Hematid Audition: Can hear the heartbeat of any living creature within 1 mile, pinpointing their location through solid objects.
Banshee Wail: Can emit a high-frequency wail as an action, forcing creatures within 30 feet to make a DC 13 CON save or be stunned for 1 round (1/day).
Vampiric Resilience: Advantage on saving throws against charm and paralysis, does not need to breathe, and has resistance to necrotic damage.
Blood Attunement: Weapons coated in blood deal an extra 1 point of necrotic damage to living targets.
character.gear: Studded leather armor · Gáe Bulg bone spear · 3x Field rations · Healing potion · 2x Torches · Tinderbox · Noise-canceling leather headphones
character.story: The only survivor of the Hollow Moors blood-mage clan's annihilation during the Red Weep, Damien's infant body fused with banshee residue from a botched ritual, cursing him to hear every heartbeat for miles. Shunned by all kingdoms, he hid in damp monastic catacombs for a decade, surviving on stolen rations and rare drops of blood. When he found the dormant Gáe Bulg in an abandoned dwarven forge, the silent spear became his anchor against the world's screaming pulse. Now he wanders the moors, a hooded, silent figure, feeding the spear's thirst on trespassers.

inventory.name: Gáe Bulg
inventory.lore: Forged by lost dwarven smiths of the Deep Holds to kill elder horrors, it lay dormant in an abandoned forge for centuries until Damien's blood awakened it, binding it to his banshee-vampiric essence.
inventory.description: Ancient dwarven bone-carved spear with a dark obsidian finish, silent in its dormant state. Absorbs the wail of Damien's affliction and feeds on enemy blood to progress through combat stages, transforming into a barbed crimson nightmare.

inventory.name: Studded Leather Armor
inventory.lore: Stolen from a dead inquisitor's corpse in the catacombs where Damien hid as a youth, it has been patched with scavenged cloth dozens of times to muffle sound for his over-sensitive ears.
inventory.description: Worn dark leather studded with cold iron, enchanted to slightly dampen ambient noise to ease Damien's hyper-sensitive hearing.

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Brewed by the last surviving blood mage of Damien's clan before the Red Weep, hidden in a secret catacomb cache for him to find when he came of age.
inventory.description: Vial of thick, crimson liquid that smells of iron and wild roses, sealing wounds and restoring vitality instantly when consumed.

inventory.name: Noise-Canceling Leather Headphones
inventory.lore: Crafted by Damien himself from the cured hide of a banshee he slew in the lower catacombs, it is the only thing that lets him sleep without being overwhelmed by the constant roar of heartbeats.
inventory.description: Stitched headphones lined with sound-dampening cave moss, which blocks out all but the most intense frequencies when activated.
inventory.effects: For 1 hour, Damien is immune to effects from auditory sources and does not suffer from Hematid Audition overload. Regains 1d3 charges at dawn.

inventory.name: Field Rations
inventory.lore: Made from the last stores of the Hollow Moors clan, each ration is stamped with the clan's sigil of a weeping heart and infused with a drop of Damien's blood to sustain his vampiric hunger.
inventory.description: Dried meat and hard bread, nutritious enough to sustain a traveler for a full day.

inventory.name: Thieves' Tools
inventory.lore: Stolen from a traveling rogue who attempted to rob Damien in the catacombs; Damien left the rogue alive but took every tool he carried.
inventory.description: Small set of well-maintained lockpicks, tension wrenches, and a tiny crowbar, perfect for picking locks or disarming traps.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Recovered from the abandoned dwarven forge where Damien discovered Gáe Bulg, it still carries a faint scent of ancient forge smoke and is resistant to rot and cutting.
inventory.description: 10 feet of sturdy, dwarven-woven hempen rope, strong enough to hold 300 lbs without breaking.

inventory.name: 2x Torches
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.

inventory.name: Tinderbox
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
